proof_availability.classification_scope: Conditional on the supplied full binary product Schur kernel and sharp variational value, root sorted singleton KKT plus prefix monotonicity gives exact full residual norm and an iff global-optimality test in O(m log m) arithmetic. General retained-tail identity and sparse support-pattern oracle give exact certificates without sector arrays. p=q=10/21, eta1=4/5,eta2=3/4 and any number of tails<=91/392 have F=1109/1190 with three signed coefficients. A general fixed-precision construction has potentially doubly exponential precision cost; not an FPTAS or demonstrated workload advantage. Physical kernel, synthesis and historical originality unacquired.
